edges.reason: withdrawAll iterates over withdrawAddresses
withdrawAll reads withdrawPercents for the split
contractBalance is assigned address(this).balance
amount = contractBalance * withdrawPercents[i] / 100 can overflow
withdrawPercents[i] multiplies the cached balance
Computed amount is the value of the low-level send
Send recipient is taken from withdrawAddresses
withdrawAll executes the low-level send
withdrawAll is gated on the Ownable _owner state
withdrawAll is protected by the onlyOwner modifier
onlyOwner reads _owner via owner()
onlyOwner compares owner() against msg.sender
supply is cached from totalSupply() before the loop
token id computed as supply + i inside reserveClown
reserveClown passes supply + i as the minted tokenId
reserveClown loop calls _safeMint which invokes an external callback
reserved tokens are minted to msg.sender
reserveClown is restricted by the owner state
revealTimeStamp is written into REVEAL_TIMESTAMP
Owner-controlled reveal timestamp determines time-gated behavior
setRevealTimestamp is restricted by the owner state
provenanceHash argument is stored
setProvenanceHash writes CLOWN_PROVENANCE
setProvenanceHash is restricted by the owner state
baseURI_ argument is written through _setBaseURI
setBaseURI is restricted by the owner state
flipSaleState negates saleIsActive
flipSaleState is restricted by the owner state
saleIsActive gates mintClown execution
numberOfTokens drives the mint loop and cap checks
maxClownPurchase bounds numberOfTokens per call
MAX_CLOWN bounds totalSupply + numberOfTokens
ClownPrice is multiplied by numberOfTokens for the payment check
msg.sender is the mint recipient and pays msg.value
mintIndex is read from totalSupply() each iteration
mintIndex is passed as tokenId to _safeMint
mintClown calls _safeMint which performs external callback before returning
block.timestamp is compared with REVEAL_TIMESTAMP in mintClown
mintClown reads REVEAL_TIMESTAMP for the reveal lock condition
mintClown assigns block.number to startingIndexBlock
startingIndexBlock is the entropy seed in setStartingIndex
setStartingIndex derives randomness from blockhash values
setStartingIndex takes the hash modulo MAX_CLOWN
setStartingIndex writes the computed startingIndex
setStartingIndex reverts unless startingIndex is still zero
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock requires startingIndex == 0
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes block.number as the seed
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock is restricted by the owner state
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received after minting
_checkOnERC721Received performs the IERC721Receiver callback on the recipient
Callback executes untrusted code in the context of the caller msg.sender
newOwner is validated and written to _owner
transferOwnership overwrites the privileged _owner slot
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTokens is only consumed by mintClown's cap and payment checks and its mint loop
revealTimeStamp is only consumed by setRevealTimestamp when writing REVEAL_TIMESTAMP
provenanceHash is only consumed by setProvenanceHash when writing CLOWN_PROVENANCE
baseURI_ is only consumed by setBaseURI before delegating to _setBaseURI
newOwner is only consumed by transferOwnership when updating _owner
contractBalance is a temporary cache created by withdrawAll
loop counter i exists solely inside withdrawAll's iteration
amount is the intermediate payout of withdrawAll consumed by its low-level send
supply is a temporary totalSupply() cache created by reserveClown
mintIndex is a temporary totalSupply() cache created by mintClown
